sn11.8:1.2: Now on that occasion the Blessed One had gone for his day’s abiding and was in seclusion.
sn11.8:1.3: Then Sakka, lord of the devas, and Verocana, lord of the asuras, approached the Blessed One and stood one at each door post.
sn11.8:1.4: Then Verocana, lord of the asuras, recited this verse in the presence of the Blessed One:
sn11.8:2.2: Until his goal has been achieved.
sn11.8:2.4: This is the word of Verocana.”
sn11.8:3.1:
Sakka:
“A man should make an effort
sn11.8:3.2: Until his goal has been achieved.
sn11.8:3.3: Of goals that shine when achieved,
sn11.8:3.4: None is found better than patience.”
sn11.8:4.1:
Verocana:
“All beings are bent on a goal
sn11.8:4.2: Here or there as fits the case,
sn11.8:4.4:
But for all creatures association
Is supreme among enjoyments.
sn11.8:4.6: This is the word of Verocana.”
sn11.8:5.1:
Sakka:
“All beings are bent upon a goal
sn11.8:5.2: Here or there as fits the case,
sn11.8:5.4:
But for all creatures association
Is supreme among enjoyments.
sn11.8:5.5: Of goals that shine when achieved,
sn11.8:5.6: None is found better than patience.”
